bar: stats2.check_bar2 (the RD-002 bar): pooled OOS expectancy_net > 0, profit_factor_net >= 1.2, >= 200 OOS episodes, >= 80% of profile folds positive with trades in at least 4 of 5 folds, and stats2.holdout2 passes (breadth: >= 50% of symbols with >= 20 OOS episodes positive; concentration: max single-symbol share of positive profit <= 50%; untouched subset - every 3rd symbol alphabetically - pooled expectancy > 0 on >= 30 episodes)

Bonferroni: one-sided p on the per-episode mean < 0.05 / N_global with N_global = 1817 (running global floor at declaration) + 96 (this family) = 1913; break-even N reported per row so verdicts can be re-checked at any larger counter
2x-cost sensitivity: at c = 0.0016 per unit turnover, pooled OOS expectancy_net > 0 AND profit_factor_net >= 1.2

CANDIDATE = all three gates. WATCHLIST = check_bar2 passes but Bonferroni or the 2x-cost gate fails. DSR (stats2.deflated_sharpe) is reported per row as a caveat, per the RD-002 precedent (the operative significance gate is Bonferroni; forward evidence is the arbiter).
benchmarks_not_trials: BTCUSDT buy-and-hold compounded return over the OOS window, per timeframe (context only)

brake.application: position held over bar t+1 = m_t * w_t
brake.driver: Shadow equity: the same configuration's per-symbol equity curve WITHOUT the brake (identical signal, vol-target sizing and costs), computed causally bar by bar. dd_t = shadow_E_t / max(shadow_E up to t) - 1. The brake state for bar t+1 is set from dd at the close of bar t.
brake.flat_05: if dd <= -0.05: m = 0 until dd >= -0.025, then m = 1
brake.flat_10: if dd <= -0.10: m = 0 until dd >= -0.05, then m = 1
brake.half_10: if dd <= -0.10: m = 0.5 until dd >= -0.05, then m = 1

episodes: A trade (episode) is a maximal run of bars with pos != 0 and constant sign(pos). A sign flip closes the old episode on its last bar and opens the new episode on the flip bar. Episode net return compounds the bars' strategy returns; turnover accounting is split at flips (the closing episode pays |pos_old| * c as exit cost on its final bar, the opening episode pays |pos_new| * c as entry cost on its first bar) and the exit turnover |pos_last| * c is charged to an episode's final bar when it closes to flat, so total turnover cost equals sum_i |pos_i - pos_{i-1}| * c exactly.
execution_and_costs: Close-to-close simple returns; the position for bar i is fixed at the close of bar i-1 (no look-ahead). Bar strategy return r_i = pos_i * asset_ret_i - |pos_i - pos_{i-1}| * c with c = 0.0008 per unit of turnover (8 bps per side = the harness crypto standard, costs2.CRYPTO, 16 bps round trip). 2x-cost sensitivity re-runs every cell at c = 0.0016.
fold_profile: STANDARD W1..W5 (rigorous_backtest.walkforward FOLDS). Episodes are attributed to folds by ENTRY time. OOS = episodes entered in [2024-07-01, 2026-11-01). Earlier data is warm-up / in-sample context only.
motivation: TASK-STR-RD-013 cross-asset rotation failed the standing bar on drawdown alone (0/48 within the 20% DD limit; best -21.0%, median -36.7%) and its completion note named the missing ingredient: a risk mechanism. This family tests exactly that mechanism - volatility-targeted position sizing plus a drawdown brake - on plain trend signals, as a NEW pre-declared family (not a retune of RD-013: different universe, different judgement unit, different signal class).
research_only: No production code, strategy registry, daemon or server state is touched and no order is placed anywhere. A passer, if any, is handed to the coordinator for the forward lane; this crew wires nothing.
sanity_anchor: Before any RD-014 number is trusted, RD-001's ts_momentum roc42_4h cell (BTCUSDT/ETHUSDT/SOLUSDT) is re-run through the untouched rd2 chain (rd2.panels -> rd2.grid.eval_single -> rd2.stats2.fold_report) and must reproduce 303 trades, expectancy_net 0.0024275740638451445, profit_factor_net 1.0969220482985518 bit-identically (the same anchor RD-008 used).

signals.ema10_50: +1 if EMA(10) of close > EMA(50), -1 if <, 0 if equal; EMA seeded at the first close, alpha = 2/(n+1)
signals.ema20_100: +1 if EMA(20) of close > EMA(100), -1 if <, 0 if equal; same EMA convention
signals.tsmom126: sign of the trailing 126-bar log return of close; 0 if exactly zero
signals.tsmom42: sign of the trailing 42-bar log return of close; 0 if exactly zero

sizing: Raw weight w_t = s_t * min(1.0, sigma_target / sigma_t), fixed at the close of bar t and held over bar t+1. sigma_t = sample stdev (ddof=1) of the trailing 42 bar log returns * sqrt(bars_per_year); bars_per_year = 2190 (4h) / 365 (1d). No position until at least 42 returns exist, and none while sigma_t == 0. Weight cap 1.0 (no leverage). Cash earns 0.
universe: crypto30 (the RD-002 CRYPTO30 list of 30 Binance USDT-M symbols), loaded from the RD-002 Stage-A verified caches (Binance Vision 1h archives, per-file SHA-256 manifests, harness data_feed contract); 4h and 1d resampled per the harness rule (UTC-aligned, complete buckets only, parent hash recorded). A series absent from the cache is skipped and reported in coverage, never substituted.
